projects.name: Flipkart AI/ML Automation Pipelines
projects.description:
Flipkart AI/ML Automation Pipelines
 Designed and implemented ML-based automation pipelines to optimize repetitive workflows, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
 Applied NLP techniques for text extraction and classification of unstructured business data, enhancing decision-making speed.
 Leveraged supervised learning models for anomaly detection and forecasting within key operational processes.
 Coordinated with cross-functional client teams to ensure smooth adoption of AI/ML solutions and provided knowledge transfer sessions for sustainable use.
RMG
Created a master dataset by integrating 7 diverse data sources, enhancing data completeness and improving model accuracy by 20%
Employed various classification models and utilized different metrics, achieving overall model accuracy of 88%.
Developed a generic function for data preprocessing and wrangling, including data profiling, cleaning, and outlier treatment, streamlining the data preparation process and reducing preparation time by 40%.
  Built a multipurpose Triage AI agent for a stock brokerage firm using MCP, enabling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on text and images, and natural language text-to-SQL queries.
 Developed an Agentic HR Workflow with LangGraph, building a scalable HR automation pipeline to handle queries on hiring, holidays, and leave policies, easily integrable with existing systems.
